title: PicardAffineStructureProjectiveModel
statement: Given f:X→S flat proper locally finitely presented with universally isomorphic structure adjunction units, M an X-module, k:W→S and affine open U⊂W with M trivial after pullback to X×S U, there is a bounded complex P of finite projective R=Gamma(W,U)-modules representing the restricted R(f_W)_*(M_W[0]) under the explicit affine sheafification functor. For every commutative R-algebra B, B tensor P has zero negative homology and zeroth homology isomorphic to the free B-module B. Derived categories of scheme modules and localized-open modules are fixed as in [def-pc-derived-category]. No normalization of terms or differentials is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the affine projective representation theorem to obtain P, its boundedness, finite projective terms, and the actual representing isomorphism. This step does not use the universal ordinary structure-unit hypothesis.

Apply the universal low-homology theorem to this same P, using its bounds, projective terms, representing isomorphism and the universal structure-unit hypothesis. Assemble these clauses with the finiteness and representation already obtained.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_affine_structure_projective_model
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (M : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (htrivial : Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf)) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} (W.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] (φ : W.presheaf.obj (.op U) →+* B),
        let PB := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
        (∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (PB.homology i)) ∧
          Nonempty (PB.homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of B B)) ∧
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
        (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((affinePerfectSheafification W U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
